_comment: Ship intentionally empty — no external source has been reviewed and approved for WEBLACK to monitor yet. Do NOT add a source here without first checking its terms of use permit automated fetching (many news sites' ToS forbid it even via a public RSS feed) and that WEBLACK has the right relationship to reuse/reference its content. Add entries following the shape below, each starting with "enabled": false until a human has reviewed it once via `npm run editorial:dry-run`.
